name: security
description: A stock, ETF or fund the user holds, watches or trades (id sec_<code>).

code.description: Exchange code (6 characters) or fund standard code. External identifier: the same code is the same security.

name.description: Name as written in the source (fund or company name).

asset_type.description: Asset type when the source states it (e.g. ETF). Left empty otherwise — never guessed.
